scenes.tts: Cut a small square from the top of a frog blastula. A blastula is the early embryo, a hollow ball of cells. Culture it in salt water, and it becomes skin. Now pull the same square apart into single cells. Keep them apart for a few hours, and they become neural tissue. Why?
scenes.visual: A ring of cells, the blastula; a square of cells lifts out into a dish and turns skin-orange; the cells are pulled apart and turn neural blue; a question mark.
scenes.narration: Cut a small square from the top of a frog blastula. A blastula is the early embryo, a hollow ball of cells. Culture it in salt water, and it becomes skin. Now pull the same square apart into single cells. Keep them apart for a few hours, and they become neural tissue. Why?

scenes.tts: The square is ectoderm, the outer layer that can make both skin and nervous system. Its cells pass a signal to one another. The candidate that emerged was B M P 4, a bone morphogenetic protein. Spread the cells apart, and on the classic reading the signal is diluted away. Later work suggests dilution may not be the whole story. Without the signal, they become neural.
scenes.caption: The square is ectoderm, the outer layer that can make both skin and nervous system. Its cells pass a signal to one another. The candidate that emerged was BMP4, a bone morphogenetic protein. Spread the cells apart, and on the classic reading the signal is diluted away. Later work suggests dilution may not be the whole story. Without the signal, they become neural.
scenes.visual: Grey ectoderm cells; yellow BMP dots appear in the gaps and the cells turn orange; the cells spread apart, the dots thin out and fade, the cells turn blue.
scenes.narration: The square is ectoderm, the outer layer that can make both skin and nervous system. Its cells pass a signal to one another. The candidate that emerged was BMP4, a bone morphogenetic protein. Spread the cells apart, and on the classic reading the signal is diluted away. Later work suggests dilution may not be the whole story. Without the signal, they become neural.

scenes.tts: Now give the separated cells B M P 4. They become skin again, and their neural genes stay off. Put the three results side by side. The intact square is skin. The separated cells are neural. The separated cells with B M P 4 are skin. In this frog tissue, neural is the default fate, and signals between cells actively suppress it.
scenes.caption: Now give the separated cells BMP4. They become skin again, and their neural genes stay off. Put the three results side by side. The intact square is skin. The separated cells are neural. The separated cells with BMP4 are skin. In this frog tissue, neural is the default fate, and signals between cells actively suppress it.
scenes.visual: Blue separated cells receive yellow BMP dots and turn orange; the group slides right as two grey panels appear and are scored skin and neural; a yellow BMP4 chip blocks a blue neural chip.
scenes.narration: Now give the separated cells BMP4. They become skin again, and their neural genes stay off. Put the three results side by side. The intact square is skin. The separated cells are neural. The separated cells with BMP4 are skin. In this frog tissue, neural is the default fate, and signals between cells actively suppress it.

scenes.tts: If B M P makes skin, the organizer should make something that blocks it. It makes at least three such proteins. Gastrulation is the set of cell movements that form the germ layers. In it, the organizer and the dorsal mesoderm turn inward and spread beneath the ectoderm. This is called involution. That tissue secretes Noggin, Chordin and Folly-statin.
scenes.caption: If BMP makes skin, the organizer should make something that blocks it. It makes at least three such proteins. Gastrulation is the set of cell movements that form the germ layers. In it, the organizer and the dorsal mesoderm turn inward and spread beneath the ectoderm. This is called involution. That tissue secretes Noggin, Chordin and Follistatin.
scenes.visual: An orange ectoderm sheet with BMP dots; an organizer chip and a green question box; purple mesoderm cells slide under the sheet; the box becomes three green chips and green dots rise.
scenes.narration: If BMP makes skin, the organizer should make something that blocks it. It makes at least three such proteins. Gastrulation is the set of cell movements that form the germ layers. In it, the organizer and the dorsal mesoderm turn inward and spread beneath the ectoderm. This is called involution. That tissue secretes Noggin, Chordin and Follistatin.

scenes.tts: None of the three needs to enter a cell. Each acts on B M P in the fluid between cells. The third, Folly-statin, does this differently, but it also works outside the cell. Noggin and Chordin bind B M P 4 and keep it off its receptors. The ectoderm directly above, cut off from B M P, becomes the neural plate.
scenes.caption: None of the three needs to enter a cell. Each acts on BMP in the fluid between cells. The third, Follistatin, does this differently, but it also works outside the cell. Noggin and Chordin bind BMP4 and keep it off its receptors. The ectoderm directly above, cut off from BMP, becomes the neural plate.
scenes.visual: Zoomed view: five ectoderm cells with receptors and bound BMP dots, mesoderm below; green dots rise outside the cells, clasp the BMP dots and pull them off the receptors; the three cells above turn blue.
scenes.narration: None of the three needs to enter a cell. Each acts on BMP in the fluid between cells. The third, Follistatin, does this differently, but it also works outside the cell. Noggin and Chordin bind BMP4 and keep it off its receptors. The ectoderm directly above, cut off from BMP, becomes the neural plate.

scenes.tts: Now predict. Give an intact square Noggin protein. Noggin catches B M P first, and the square becomes neural. Jam the B M P receptor, and the result is the same. Add B M P 4 to separated cells, and they return to skin. Keep one rule. In the frog, ectoderm becomes neural unless B M P signaling tells it otherwise.

scenes.visual: A row of cells run through three cases, each reset to a neutral state: Noggin catches BMP; a jammed receptor; BMP4 added to separated cells. Then the rule: ectoderm becomes neural, with BMP signaling blocking the arrow.
